approvedDesignText:
Add repeatable `--field <name>` and `--field-id <id>` flags to `gh project item-list`. They are table-only selectors: either form may be repeated, their requested order determines appended column order, and repeated entries within the same form intentionally produce duplicate columns. The two forms are mutually exclusive, even if they resolve to the same field. Either selector is also rejected before any API request when `--format json`, `--jq`, or `--template` was explicitly supplied. Existing invocations without selectors, including existing structured output, retain their current behavior.

After the normal project-items request, resolve selectors against the project’s returned field definitions. Name matching is case-insensitive; the displayed header uses the field’s configured name. Unknown names report the requested name plus sorted available names, unknown IDs report sorted `name (id)` alternatives, and duplicate case-insensitive names report the matching IDs and direct the user to `--field-id`. Resolution happens before table rendering (and before the no-items error) so invalid choices never appear as empty or incorrect columns.

The initial item query’s field definitions are reused directly. Only when a selector was requested and that response reports additional field pages will the client fetch and append the remaining field pages before resolution; no additional field-resolution request is made for unselected item lists or projects whose initial fields are complete.

Render the existing Type, Title, Number, Repository, and ID columns unchanged, then append one column for every resolved selector. An item with no value for a selected field renders an empty cell. Render known Projects field values in readable table form: date/text/single-select as their text, numbers without display-artifact zeroes, iteration and milestone by title, labels/users/reviewers as comma-separated names, and pull requests/repositories as comma-separated URLs or URL. Unknown value types render empty rather than a misleading representation.

Update command help/examples, add focused unit tests for flag parsing and incompatibilities, selection order/duplicates, each value-display category, invalid and ambiguous resolution, selected fields beyond the first returned field page, and proof that no supplemental field request occurs without selectors. Run the relevant package tests and the broader local test suite before review.
